dct_description_sm: As part of the Northern Oil and Gas Action Program (NOGAP), this project aimed to characterize the meiobenthic and macrobenthic communities, to determine the extent of interannual variability in numbers and biomass of these communities, and to relate these results to chemical and physical attributes in the sediment and water column. Other objectives were to develop sampling and analysis methods and to evaluate approaches for future effects monitoring programs.
dct_title_s: Meio- and macrobenthos, and related bottom sediment from Tuktoyaktuk Harbour and Mason Bay, N.W.T., March, 1985 to 1988 (NOGAP B2)
